title: Ten Simple Marks
brief: Ten plain marks around one circle, every one of them rank-one notation. Nothing here is hard to draw; the work is drawing ten of them small enough to stay apart and even enough to stay legible. Start at the top and go round.

title: Nine Sharper Marks
brief: One mark fewer, and every one of them costlier notation. Rank-two runes carry more strokes than the starter shelf did, and a stroke you rush is a stroke the circle misreads. Draw each mark whole before moving to the next.
